digest.component_or_area: MCP adapter / transition and claim write surfaces
propositions: MCP transition_ticket and claim_ticket omit write parameters (force, reason, caused_by, ref) already supported by the library and CLI, making them unreachable over MCP because FastMCP derives input models from handwritten callable signatures and drops undeclared extras.

The handwritten MCP adapter calls in _mcp_writes.py forward only close_class for transition and assignee for claim, so even if signatures declared the missing fields, they would still be lost at the delegate boundary.
The 2026-08-18 operator ruling rescinds the prior force-only-CLI policy and establishes parity across all surfaces (CLI, library, MCP) with absent certification as the audit signal.

Transition and claim must expose and forward the full parameter set unchanged to the shared library core (rebar.transition and rebar.claim) to restore parity and reach reason-required closes, explicit culprit attribution, explicit completion refs, and authorized bypasses.
